input.rationale: Section 5.1 gives a services-quality warranty (reasonable care and skill, qualified personnel) plus a compliance-with-laws covenant, which broadly matches the professional/workmanlike limb. However, there is no conformance warranty for Deliverables or Materials at all — Section 5.4(c) affirmatively puts all Materials on an "AS IS" basis, Section 5.4(a)-(b) disclaims error-free operation, defect correction, capacity and performance, and Section 5.2 makes 5.1 exclusive — and the Agreement states no repair/replace/refund or re-performance remedy for defective work. That fails the fallback on two material terms (no conformance warranty period, no remedy), and the "AS IS" treatment of Materials is the rule's walk-away position. The redline adds a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty for Deliverables/Materials with re-performance, repair, replacement or refund, and carves the express warranties out of the disclaimer; 90 days (the preferred services figure) is used rather than a longer software period given this is a hosting services engagement.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day conformance/no-malicious-code warranty with repair, replace or refund remedy, and carve the express warranty out of the "AS IS" Materials disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5.1 warrants only care and skill in performing the Services, while Section 5.4(c) puts all Materials on an "AS IS" basis with no conformance warranty and the Agreement gives us no stated remedy, so we have added a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty for Materials and Deliverables with re-performance, repair, replacement or refund, and excepted the express warranties from the disclaimer.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Deliverable and all Materials will conform in all material respects to their documentation and the applicable Service Option Attachment, and will be free of any virus, malicious or destructive code. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services, Deliverable or Materials.
